notes: D1 oracle is Wikipedia's Copenhagen Metro station list + individual station infoboxes (Nordhavn, Nørrebro, Nørreport, Copenhagen Central Station), hand-transcribed and cross-validated against the 'Time to Nørreport' minute column and each station's own Adjacent-stations table. Not generated from GTFS, not generated from the Rejseplanen API. The oracle report pointed at the official m.dk Metro map and this Wikipedia list as D1 sources but did not itself transcribe station rosters; this pack did the transcription against the Wikipedia source since it is directly checkable (infobox + adjacent-stations tables agree with each other independently) and is one of the oracle report's own named D1 sources.

City id copenhagen is unused in existing packs. Agency is three operators over one shared Rejseplanen feed (Metroselskabet, S-tog/DSB, DSB Regional/InterCity/Öresundståg) - not city=denmark, not merged into a national adapter (see denmark-ledger.md: Copenhagen is a CONFIG over a shared provider, not its own clone, but still its own city id/pack).

City stays planned until Jim wires testers, and per this task's explicit instruction, Jim's Copenhagen adapter work is deferred to a supervised session, not the unattended pipeline. assertCityLive("copenhagen") must fail.

Modes v1: Metro M1-M4 (44 stations, full network) PLUS S-tog (A, B, Bx, C, E, H, F) PLUS DSB Regional/InterCity/InterCityLyn PLUS Öresundståg, the latter three scoped ONLY to Nørreport, Nørrebro, København H, Nordhavn (not the full S-tog/DSB network - those corridors are not in this catalog; no stop-level data sourced for them beyond these four stations). No buses, no harbour ferries, no DSB EuroCity (out-reservation), no SJ/České dráhy (unverdicted - see sources note above).
Timezone Europe/Copenhagen HAS DST. Do not copy no-DST cities.

Locked inner-city hub: Kongens Nytorv (Metro-only, all four lines M1-M4, confirmed zero rail/S-tog transfer in its own station-list row). Not Nørreport, not København H, not Nørrebro, not Nordhavn - those four are shared/multi-operator approach stations with their own three-or-four-way doNotGroup treatment (see printedInnerCityNames below and direction-model-memo.md).

44 unique Metro stations, verified by direct count of the Wikipedia station-list table (44 rows) and cross-checked by summing each line's station count (M1 15, M2 16 with 22 unique across M1+M2's shared 9-station trunk, M3 17, M4 13, all unique names deduplicated across shared nodes Kongens Nytorv/Frederiksberg/København H/Gammel Strand/Marmorkirken/Østerport/Rådhuspladsen) = 44.

S-tog line-membership correction (hazard-pack.md H2): Nordhavn is FIVE S-tog lines (A, B, Bx, C, E) not six - line H stopped serving Nordhavn in 2017, confirmed by both Nordhavn's own infobox/adjacent-stations table and the H line's own article. Nørreport is SIX S-tog lines (A, B, Bx, C, E, H) not just C as the oracle report's C2/C3 section implied - confirmed by Nørreport's own infobox line field.

gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown are the printed passenger line codes (M1-M4, A/B/Bx/C/E/H/F) for Metro/S-tog. DSB Regional/InterCity/InterCityLyn/Öresundståg have NO printed passenger-facing line code (Wikipedia's internal route ids like 'R51'/'ICCphEs' are editorial shorthand, not signage) - direction is service-type + destination, see direction-model-memo.md section 3. No stopIds in this file.

Feed / live (Jim D2, not a D1 generator): Rejseplanen API 2.0 departureBoard (confirmed covers Metro + S-tog + DSB + Öresundståg, ~1 min latency, per the oracle report) or SIRI-ET via Dataudveksleren NAP. Static Rejseplanen GTFS is NOT a D1 generator. D1 stays planned.

Two services observed calling at København H in the primary source data have NO board-eligibility verdict from the oracle report: SJ (Stockholm, Southern Main Line) and České dráhy (Prague, RJ). NOT included in this catalog. This is a gap to flag back to Nico/Tim, not a decision made here - see hazard-pack.md H3 and direction-model-memo.md open question 3.

Öresundståg additionally calls Nørreport per København H's own Adjacent-stations data (all four Öresundståg corridors list Nørreport as a call point, not just København H) - the oracle report's Board eligibility table only named København H for Öresundståg. Recommend extending the verdict to Nørreport (same service, same boarding contract) but this is Tim's call, not assumed in this file - Öresundståg is included at BOTH stations below since the boarding-contract evidence (no compulsory reservation) applies identically; flagged as an open question for confirmation, not a silent scope creep.
coverageGaps: S-tog network beyond Nørreport/Nørrebro/København H/Nordhavn (the rest of A, B, Bx, C, E, H, F's routes) - not in this catalog, per v1 scope. No stop-level data sourced for those other S-tog stations.
DSB Regional/InterCity/InterCityLyn/Öresundståg network beyond Nørreport and København H - not in this catalog.
DSB EuroCity (Hamburg-Copenhagen) at København H - out-reservation (compulsory 26 Jun-16 Aug), excluded per oracle report board-eligibility verdict.
SJ (Stockholm) and České dráhy (Prague) at København H - observed in the source data, NOT board-eligibility-verdicted by the oracle report. Excluded pending that verdict, not a decided 'out'.
Harbour buses (Havnebus 991/992) at Orientkaj - out-mode, buses/ferries excluded v1.
Aarhus (Aarhus Letbane) - unscoped, Later per docs/denmark-ledger.md. Not this pack's concern; no stop-ownership boundary drawn yet since only Copenhagen is planned.

København S (Ny Ellebjerg, renamed 2024) has its own S-train/regional interchange per the Metro station-list 'Transfer' column, but is NOT one of the oracle report's four named shared stations - no board-eligibility verdict recorded for S-tog/regional service AT København S itself. Flagged, not decided.
